description: Mina, a home baker, must decide whether to accept a neighbor's barter proposal for a custom birthday cake in exchange for family photography, and finalize the cake, photo, pickup, and comparison terms after hearing from the people at the kitchen-table planning session.

agents.name: Jon
agents.role: Neighbor with Knowledge of Another Offer

shared_context.S1: Mina makes custom birthday cakes informally for people in the neighborhood.
shared_context.S2: Mina has one Saturday-afternoon baking opportunity available this month.
shared_context.S3: Mina has been hoping to get a family portrait session, and Ari does photography as a side business.
shared_context.S4: Mina makes the final call on whether to accept the arrangement and what terms to record.
shared_context.S5: As part of Mina's usual planning routine, she asks Ari and Jon for relevant terms before settling an informal deal.
shared_context.S6: The planning session takes place at Mina's kitchen table, where everyone can review the calendar and write agreed terms in a shared notebook.
shared_context.S7: Mina normally confirms the pickup plan, the exchanged services, and any competing commitments before agreeing to a neighborhood arrangement.
shared_context.S8: The shared notebook has a routine disclosure step: each person must enter their own complete proposal or offer using the notebook's formal disclosure entry before Mina can finalize, and Mina records the disclosed fact ID when relying on it.
shared_context.S9: The notebook's arrangement field uses the exact label "Ari barter" for accepting Ari's proposal.

PF1.text: Ari's complete proposal is a two-tier birthday cake serving exactly 40 people, with no cash payment, exchanged for one outdoor family portrait session producing exactly 20 edited digital photographs; Ari can have the cake picked up Saturday at exactly 2:00 p.m.

PF2.text: Jon has been offered a separate cash cake order for exactly $210, but that customer requires Sunday pickup, so it cannot use Mina's available Saturday-afternoon baking opportunity.

decisions.selected_arrangement: string; use exactly "Ari barter" when accepting Ari's proposal
decisions.cake_servings: integer; record the exact number of servings promised
decisions.cash_payment: integer; record the exact cash payment exchanged
decisions.portrait_photos: integer; record the exact number of edited digital photographs promised
decisions.portrait_session_committed: boolean; indicate whether the photography exchange is committed
decisions.pickup_day: string; record the agreed pickup day
decisions.pickup_time: string; record the agreed pickup time
decisions.alternative_cash_offer: integer; record the exact cash amount of the alternative cake order
decisions.alternative_pickup_day: string; record the pickup day required by the alternative order

acceptance_conditions: Ari's barter arrangement must be selected using the notebook label "Ari barter".
The cake commitment must record exactly 40 servings and $0 cash.
Ari must commit to one outdoor family portrait session with exactly 20 edited digital photographs.
The cake pickup must be recorded as Saturday at exactly 2:00 p.m.
The separate alternative must be recorded as exactly $210 cash with Sunday pickup.
Ari's complete proposal must be formally disclosed and cited as justification.
Jon's alternative offer must be formally disclosed and cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: Ari's proposal changes the selected arrangement and the required recorded terms to 40 servings, $0 cash, 20 edited photographs, a portrait session, and Saturday pickup at 2:00 p.m.
Jon's information changes the alternative-order fields from unknown values to exactly $210 cash and Sunday pickup, and supplies the fact that must be formally cited for that comparison.
